title: ApexBrasil e Sebrae selecionam 20 startups brasileiras para incubação em Lisboa (DN Brasil)
what_it_says: The 2027 cycle of the Lisbon incubation programme: up to 40 to a strategic exploration stage, top 20 onward, announced during Web Summit; bonus points for HealthTech, EnergyTech, ClimaTech, TravelTech, AgTech, Biotech.
